```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
resumen <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    summarise(
      across(
        where(is.numeric), 
        list(
          N = ~ n(),
          `Valid (n)` = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
          Min = ~ round(min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q1 = ~ round(quantile(.x, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Median = ~ round(median(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Mean = ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Q3 = ~ round(quantile(.x, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          Max = ~ round(max(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
          `Missing (n)` = ~ sum(is.na(.x)),
          `Missing (%)` = ~ round((sum(is.na(.x)) / n()) * 100, 2)
        ),
        .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = everything(),
      names_to = c("Variable", "Estadistico"),
      names_sep = "__"
    ) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = Estadistico,
      values_from = value
    )
}
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
df <- read_csv("/kaggle/input/datasets/diegorestrepoleal/measurement-of-t-h-pm-and-radiation/Dht22_PM_Piranometro.csv")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
df %>%
    resumen()
```
